aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes software for food trucks: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

comparison.costs.cardFee: Online card payments with HatchGrab also carry Stripe's fees: {cardFee} per card payment in {country}.
comparison.costs.vat: HatchGrab Ltd is a UK company and is not registered for VAT in {country}, so no VAT is added to our fees. If you are registered for VAT, give us your VAT number; you then account for any VAT on our fees yourself, under the reverse charge.
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system works from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on site, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.

comparison.fit.appClause: Or if you need the kitchen app on iPad or Android in {country}: it isn't in the stores there yet.
comparison.fit.marketplacesBody: Delivery platforms bring new customers but take commission on every order. Uber Eats states 14% for takeaway orders and 30% for delivery by Uber couriers in Germany. Wolt says on its own website that it charges commission but gives no rates. We could not check Lieferando’s rates. That commission applies to regulars who pre-order with you, too.
comparison.fit.oursBody: you trade at changing locations, want pre-orders with a collection time, don't want your kitchen overloaded, and don't want a contract.
